name: claude-skillet
description: Personal Claude Code skills, packaged one plugin per skill so each can be installed and toggled independently.

plugins.name: glass-ui
plugins.description: Glassmorphism / Liquid Glass-style translucent UI done right: calibrated opacity, blur, and border values per theme and density, ambient-background requirements, performance budgets, and reduced-transparency accessibility fallbacks.

plugins.name: lucide-icons
plugins.description: Lucide icon selection that never hallucinates a name: a searchable index of all 1,776 icons with keywords, a verify-before-use workflow, and usage patterns for vanilla JS, React, Vue, and Svelte.

plugins.name: primer-colors
plugins.description: GitHub Primer semantic color tokens as a ready-to-paste CSS file — complete dark, dark-dimmed, and light themes for admin panels, internal tools, and data-dense dashboards.

plugins.name: tidy
plugins.description: Pre-clear housekeeping: before /clear and a switch to unrelated work, update memory and project docs, commit or report the working tree, and finish or surface anything in flight, then confirm it's safe to clear.

plugins.name: wp-ops
plugins.description: Safe WordPress operations via WP-CLI, local or over SSH: per-project install registry, pre-op DB snapshots, cache-layer purge ordering, dual-row ACF handling, and sanitized prod-to-local cloning.

plugins.name: wrap
plugins.description: End-of-session close-out: sweep memory, project docs, working tree, lingering processes, and loose ends, then confirm it's safe to close the terminal.
